glibc stack-guard bypass disputed upstream, not a vulnerability by itself

CoreDNS v1.4.0 resolver flaw: a forged DNS response against the source port of CoreDNS's resolver. coredns is only an indirect dependency (go.mod) and juicefs starts no CoreDNS resolver or server. Checked: the driver (v0.34.0 pkg/, cmd/) runs only 'juicefs' subcommands format, status, config, quota set, rmr and version from /usr/local/bin/juicefs; none of cmd/format.go, status.go, config.go, quota.go, rmr.go, version.go starts a server, and the only listener in juicefs cmd/main.go is a debug agent on 127.0.0.1:6060+. Checked at juicefs commit 23d2a456, the last main commit before the image was created (2026-11-20; the Dockerfile builds juicefs from main). The govulncheck result for usr/local/bin/juicefs (digest sha256:1b5e3667) lists the symbol as linked only as a dependency of the binary, so the code is present but no entry path runs it.

pam_namespace symlink/race privilege escalation by a local user at PAM login or session setup. Nothing in the container opens a PAM session: ENTRYPOINT is tini then the driver, and the driver's exec calls are juicefs, umount, rm, sh and bash only (grep of pkg/ and cmd/ at v0.34.0; no login, su, sudo or sshd). Local vector (AV:L).

curl tool with a schemeless URL and --proto-default sftp/scp: needs SSH on port 22. The driver never runs curl or loads libcurl (its exec calls are juicefs, umount, rm, sh and bash; grep of pkg/ and cmd/ at v0.34.0; curl is used only in the Dockerfile build). Pods' egress (CiliumNetworkPolicy juicefs-csi) allows only garage:3900, juicefs-meta Postgres:5432, kubelet:10250, the kube-apiserver and DNS. Only the EE CLI path /usr/bin/juicefs (a script) is outside this: it is run only for Enterprise-edition secrets, and this cluster mounts with the CE mount image juicedata/mount:ce-v1.4.2.

Flaw is in systemd-homed (local privilege escalation of a logged-in homed user). Image ENTRYPOINT is /tini -g -- juicefs-csi-driver (crane config), so systemd is not PID 1 and homed never runs; the driver's exec calls are juicefs, umount, rm, sh and bash only (grep of pkg/ and cmd/ at v0.34.0). Local vector (AV:L); nobody logs in to the container.

CVE-2026-78661 is in x/net/html parsing. Not verified whether the binary links it. No untrusted HTML reaches this workload: default-deny CiliumNetworkPolicy, ingress only from kube-apiserver/node/cluster, egress only to named hosts (GitHub, ghcr, quay, Let's Encrypt, Cloudflare API). Fix: x/net v0.62.0 via Renovate.

crypto/tls ECH memory exhaustion affects a TLS server. juicefs-csi-driver (CGO_ENABLED=0) listeners are plain HTTP: metrics on :8082 (controller-runtime, no SecureServing), promhttp metrics and pprof on localhost; no ServeTLS/tls.Listen in cmd/ or pkg/. juicefs starts no server in the invoked subcommands (only a 127.0.0.1 debug agent). Other TLS code in juicefs (pkg/fs/http.go) is not an entry point of those subcommands.
